mapper.select: select order_id, order_no, username, biz_type, biz_id, biz_ref, product_name, amount, pay_type, status, trade_no, pay_url, qrcode_url, client_ip, notify_time, pay_time, create_time, update_time, remark from edu_pay_order where biz_type = #{bizType} and status = 'paid' order by coalesce(pay_time, create_time) desc, order_id desc limit #{limit}

select order_id, order_no, username, biz_type, biz_id, biz_ref, product_name, amount, pay_type, status, trade_no, pay_url, qrcode_url, client_ip, notify_time, pay_time, create_time, update_time, remark from edu_pay_order where order_no = #{orderNo}
mapper.insert: insert into edu_pay_order ( order_no, username, biz_type, biz_id, biz_ref, product_name, amount, pay_type, status, pay_url, qrcode_url, client_ip, create_time ) values ( #{orderNo}, #{username}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{bizRef}, #{productName}, #{amount}, #{payType}, #{status}, #{payUrl}, #{qrcodeUrl}, #{clientIp}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: update edu_pay_order set status = #{status}, trade_no = #{tradeNo}, notify_time = #{notifyTime}, pay_time = #{payTime}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where order_no = #{orderNo} and status = 'pending'
